title: Shared definitions
description: Vocabulary reused by every artifact schema. The unit enum is asserted against pcbv.units.KNOWN_UNITS by tests/test_units.py so code and schema cannot drift.

unit.description: Allowed unit spellings. Units never appear inside a value string.

quantity.description: A physical value. Always a mapping; '3.3V' as a string is invalid by construction.

fact_status.description: Lifecycle of an engineering fact. Everything starts UNKNOWN.

evidence_level.description: A = datasheet, B = app note / hardware design guideline, C = reference design, D = official distributor, E = reputable third party, F = inference.

basis.description: How a gate result was established. Says nothing about pass/fail; a PASS with only LLM_ASSERTED basis can never satisfy a mandatory gate.

source_kind.description: A datasheet is not the only authority; critical constraints often live in a hardware design guideline or errata.

source_document.description: A retrievable authoritative document, pinned by content hash so a revision change invalidates dependent requirements.

local_path.description: Path to the cached PDF, relative to the project root.

sha256.description: Hash of the exact bytes the citations were extracted from.

citation.description: A pointer into a source document that a script can re-check. The snippet is verbatim, and snippet_verified is written only by the citation verifier -- never by hand and never by an agent.

snippet.description: Verbatim text from the source. Must be found in the cached extracted text or the requirement fails.

snippet_verified.description: Set by scripts/verify_citations only. Absent or false means unverified.

graded_citation.description: A citation that also carries its evidence level. Defined as its own object rather than composed from 'citation' with allOf: because citation sets additionalProperties:false, an allOf composition would reject the extra property and silently accept anything instead of enforcing the policy.

verified_value.description: A quantity plus its provenance. VERIFIED requires a non-null value and at least one citation.

identifier.description: Stable machine identifier: uppercase alphanumeric with dashes and underscores.

requirement_id.description: Stable requirement ID, e.g. ESP-PWR-004 or USB-ESD-001.

refdes.description: Schematic reference designator, e.g. U1, C12, J3.

package_name.description: Package identity. Pin tables are always qualified by this.

person.description: A human. Never written by an agent.

check_id.description: Identifier of a deterministic check, e.g. CHK-PIN-MAP.

finding_code.description: Sub-code distinguishing failure modes within one check.
